_comment: S4 (spec/rules/selection.md). `modules` is the protected set the basename-contains-selection matcher cannot see; every item is a repo path. Basename `selection` is a fail-closed net so selectionReader.ts cannot silently escape. `outOfScope` is a decision that a file is not a selection module — not a waiver. `entries` waive a live site in an in-scope file; each needs file, enclosing symbol, kind (a timer name, or promise-then, async, await, scheduler-setter, retry-counter), and a reason that names why the site remains. Remove an entry in the same PR that deletes the call. R1's pointer-settled microtask in selectionReader.ts is a structural match in the rule, not an entry.

outOfScope.reason: Focuses the prompt's own native textarea (HOST9); it never reads or writes editor selection.
AX3 control focus on table chrome; cell selection lives in cellEditingController.ts, which is in scope.
AX3 control focus on the block handle; it writes no selection.
